get_data: read a JSON file of DFT and force field data points and split into CO2 and H2O datasets
binned_average: compute the average prediction error within user-defined energy bins for force field analysis
get_Fig4a: generate a histogram comparing raw force field minus DFT errors for CO2 and H2O configurations
get_Fig4b: plot binned average force field error versus DFT interaction energy with KDE density overlay
phys_err: calculate the mean absolute error for physisorption regime where DFT energies are between -0.5 and 0 eV
